title: Doc-drift cleanup: wizard help text reviewer=fable → inherit
description:
Two non-blocking doc-drift LOWs surfaced by the TASK-042 review (the fable→inherit reviewer model change). Neither affects behavior; both would mislead a future reader/operator.

(1) src/question-library.js lines ~75 and ~85: the agent-models wizard prompt help text still reads 'Defaults: reviewer=fable, developer=sonnet, researcher=sonnet'. This is DISPLAY help text (not an applied default — the applied default lives in the applier/schema, unchanged), but a fresh `node bin/init.js` intake would now suggest fable for the reviewer, contradicting the TASK-042 policy. Update the reviewer default in the help text to inherit. Check whether any spec asserts this exact wording and update it in lockstep if so.

(2) tests/verification-policy-docs.spec.js line 274: a stale COMMENT in the 'Pinned-assertion collision report' still describes /reviewer/i && /fable/i as what agent-models.spec.js asserts. It is a comment only (no executable assertion), but it now describes a retired contract. Update the comment to reflect reviewer+inherit.

Pure text/doc change — no applier mechanism, no valid-alias list (fable STAYS a valid alias), no logic.
acceptance_criteria: src/question-library.js agent-models wizard help text shows the reviewer default as inherit (not fable); developer/researcher still sonnet; any spec pinning the help-text wording updated in lockstep and green.
tests/verification-policy-docs.spec.js line ~274 comment updated to describe the current reviewer+inherit contract; no executable assertion changed.
fable remains a valid alias everywhere (VALID_MODEL_ALIASES / MODEL_ALIASES / AGENT_MODEL_ALIASES untouched); npm run test:changed plus affected specs green.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Plan + tier: verification_tier=uat-only (pure display-text/comment change, no logic, no applier, fable stays a valid alias). Developer in IMPL only, no new specs; verified via UAT (grep + a wizard help-text render check). Must rebuild dist (question-library.js is bundled into dist/init.cjs). Scaled gate: test:changed + any spec pinning the help-text wording. fable remains valid everywhere (alias lists untouched).

comments.author: uat
comments.body:
UAT — doc-drift fix, verified by Orchestrator at the human's standing delegation (uat-only, 2-line text change; a full fresh-context reviewer would be disproportionate for a display-string fix).

1. AC1 help text: EXPECT the agent-models wizard prompt + nearby comment show reviewer=inherit (not fable), developer/researcher still sonnet. OBSERVED src/question-library.js:106 (comment) and :116 (prompt) both read "Defaults: reviewer=inherit, developer=sonnet, researcher=sonnet"; grep for reviewer=fable in src/ returns NONE. → PASS.
2. AC2 stale comment: EXPECT tests/verification-policy-docs.spec.js ~line 274 comment describes reviewer+inherit, no executable assertion changed. OBSERVED comment updated to /reviewer/i && /inherit/i; verification-policy-docs.spec.js 7/7 green. → PASS.
3. AC3 fable still valid + dist + green: EXPECT alias lists untouched, dist rebuilt, tests green. OBSERVED 'fable' still present in all three alias sets (question-library.js:138, project-md.js:96, agent-generator.js:268); npm run build:plugin → git diff --stat dist/ EMPTY (committed bundle matches fresh build); test:changed 7/7 + fast tier 171/2. → PASS.

OVERALL: PASS (3/3). All ACs covered.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: CLOSED — uat-only, done on UAT 3/3 PASS (verified by orchestrator per the human's standing delegation; a full fresh-context review is disproportionate for a display-string + comment change). Wizard agent-models help text now reflects the TASK-042 reviewer=inherit policy; stale spec comment aligned; fable preserved as a valid alias everywhere; dist parity verified. Both v0.3.0 post-release follow-ups (TASK-043, TASK-044) now closed.
